title: Marquee jumps a character on every poll; title/album lines crowd together
description: User 2026-11-08: 'marquee is not working properly' and 'now playing icon has state title and album title at the same row'. Live recording: every poll re-render advanced the marquee an extra character (two frames 50 ms apart every 10 s). buildMarqueeRenderIntent joined title and album windows with one newline (two cramped top rows); with state-based title on, the album line was dropped. Fix: advance only on render-ticker frames; title top row, album bottom row; play/pause shows state label top + album bottom.
close_reason: Marquee advances only on render-ticker frames (poll/action redraws repeat the frame); track title on the top row, album on the bottom row; play/pause with state label shows label top + album bottom instead of dropping the album.

title: Volume up/down before first poll sets absolute low volume
description: Fable order review #6. sonosActions.js:287,310,388: current = volume ?? 0, so pressing Volume Up before the first poll sends SetVolume(increment), e.g. 10. Fix: fetch getVolume() when unknown or return ERROR.
close_reason: currentLevel() reads volume/bass/treble from the speaker when state has no value; Volume Up/Down and the dial no longer assume 0. Read failure -> ERROR, nothing sent.

title: No render on willAppear / didReceiveSettings
description: Fable order review #2. lifecycle.js:59-81, 92-118. Keys on an already-polled speaker (page switch, folder, 2nd key) show manifest default until next poll (~10s); PI toggle changes (album art, state title, encoder target) also wait for next poll. Fix: force refreshStateAndTitle when speaker.state exists, else lastChecked=0.
close_reason: lifecycle renderNow(): willAppear and didReceiveSettings force-render from known speaker state, or set lastChecked=0 when the speaker has no state yet.

title: RATE_LIMITED speaker never resumes polling
description: Fable order review #3. pollingSupervisor.js:118-124, SonosSpeakers.js:98-112. Failed poll doesn't set lastChecked, so fast failures hit RATE_LIMITED; tick() skips RATE_LIMITED forever; only a key press clears it. Keys stay frozen after speaker returns. Fix: back off via lastChecked on failure; let tick retry RATE_LIMITED after the window.
close_reason: Failed polls set lastChecked (back off one interval); tick() re-polls RATE_LIMITED speakers once the attempt window has elapsed.

title: In-flight poll overwrites keyDown projection
description: Fable order review 2026-11-08 #1. pollingSupervisor.js:67-98 / actionDispatcher.js:107-128. Poll started before a key press returns pre-press state and overwrites the projection (play/pause, volume, mute, play mode) for up to deviceCheckInterval; also overwrites lastChecked so afterAction's forced re-poll for favorites is lost. Fix: speaker.stateVersion bumped by callAction; pollSpeaker discards results if it changed; reset lastChecked=0 after every successful action.
close_reason: speaker.stateVersion bumped before and after every action; pollSpeaker drops results if the version changed while in flight; successful actions set lastChecked=0 for an immediate confirming re-poll.

title: Play Favorite keys own their face: only the active favorite shows track title/marquee/live art
description: Verified 2026-11-08: buildMarqueeRenderIntent ignores selectedSonosFavorite, so every favorite key on a speaker shows/scrolls the speaker's current track (Kendrick Lamar Mix key and Today's Top Hits key both rendered 'luther (wi'...), and all show the TV icon when the speaker is on TV input. Desired: per speaker, remember which favorite key last started playback (set on keyDown success; cleared when another favorite key on that speaker is pressed, or the source changes to TV / line-in / another URI not from this favorite). Active key = owner AND playbackState PLAYING or PAUSED_PLAYBACK: favorite name on top, track title on bottom, marquee scrolls, live album art. Every other favorite key: favorite name only, no track title (replaying restarts the playlist), no scrolling, its own favorite artwork. PI toggles for this action: Display Favorite Name, Display Track Title, Marquee, Display Album Art. Radio favorites can also be matched by currentURI == favorite uri. Investigate AVTransport EnqueuedTransportURI for detecting playlist changes started from the Sonos app.
design: AGREED DESIGN v2 (2026-11-08). PI toggles for play-sonos-favorite: Display Favorite Name, Display Track Title (shown only while ACTIVE), Marquee, Display Favorite Artwork, Display Track/Album Artwork (only while ACTIVE). ACTIVE = this key's favorite started the speaker's current session: radio favorites match currentURI == favorite uri; queue favorites match the queue signature (Browse Q:0 UpdateID + TotalMatches) recorded right after the key's load completes; plus source is the queue and state is PLAYING/PAUSED_PLAYBACK. No last-track persistence: track title/art come from live speaker state, but only rendered on the ACTIVE key. Art precedence: ACTIVE + track art on -> track art; otherwise favorite art on -> selectedSonosFavorite.albumArtURI (refresh from favorites list on Save and Reconnect); otherwise default key image. Example: Kendrick active -> press Top Hits -> Kendrick reverts to favorite art, no title, no scroll; Top Hits renders current track art + title. Open questions: sig persistence across restart, STOPPED handling, duplicate-favorite keys, long inactive names, migration of displayAlbumArt/displayMarqueeTitle.
notes: Live sequence 2026-11-08 verified: inactive keys show favorite art; active key gets track art + marquee; paused keeps active; switching favorite reverts the other key; TV input reverts both after next poll (~10s). Remaining: restart while a favorite queue is loaded should keep the key active.
close_reason: All live checks passed 2026-11-08: active key gets track art/title, others revert to favorite art; paused stays active; switching favorites and TV input revert correctly; after a Stream Deck restart with the Top Hits queue still loaded, the Top Hits key came back active.

title: Marquee scrolls one character per poll (~10s), looks frozen
description: computeMarqueeWindow only advances inside buildMarqueeRenderIntent, which runs on poll/refresh. With deviceCheckInterval 10s, live capture showed setTitle 'h sza)    ' -> ' sza)    l' -> 'sza)    lu' at ~10.5s steps. Needs a local marquee ticker (~400-600ms) that re-renders only marquee-enabled keys from cached speaker state without polling the speaker.
close_reason: Local 500ms render ticker re-renders only scrolling keys from cached state; title sends deduped on visible text.

title: Album art never shows for queue playback: Sonos /getaa path is relative
description: GetPositionInfo returns upnp:albumArtURI as a relative path (e.g. /getaa?s=1&u=x-sonos-spotify...). marquee.ensureAlbumArtCached only fetches http(s) URLs and returns anything else unchanged, so setImage gets '/getaa?...' and Stream Deck shows nothing. Fix: resolve relative art against http://<speaker host>:1400 before caching. Verified live 2026-11-08: fetch from the plugin page (origin file://) to http://192.168.50.80:1400/getaa... returns 200 image/jpeg 70KB, so no CORS issue. Also re-render keys when a fetch completes instead of waiting for the next poll.
notes: REGRESSION vs released 1.0.2.5: its SonosController.getAlbumArtURI did 'if (r && !r.startsWith("http")) r = http://${host}:${port}${r}'. The rewrite (sonosController.js getPositionInfo / browse parsing) dropped this. Restore it at parse time (position info + favorites/queue browse).
close_reason: Relative /getaa art resolved against the speaker (absoluteArtURI) for position info, favorites and queue; keys redraw when art downloads (render ticker art listener).

title: PI Speaker Bindings section + missing-speaker warning (per approved mockup)
description: Approved mockup: docs/mockups/pi-speaker-bindings.html. Under Save and Reconnect in Global Settings: one card per speaker bound by on-screen buttons (zone, IP, RINCON id, Online/Not found/Replaced badge, on-screen button count). Not-found cards get a Replace-with select (preselect same-room non-satellite) + Replace button, which writes speakerReplacements {oldUuid: newUuid} into global settings. Active replacements list with Undo. Top-of-PI warning with Fix link when the current button's speaker is not in the household. Plugin must send the bound-speaker summary (uuid, zoneName, hostAddress, count) to the PI via sendToPropertyInspector, since only the plugin knows on-screen contexts. Extend buildGlobalSettingsPayload to keep speakerReplacements.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright scenario reproduces the Office replacement: old speaker shows Not found, Replace repoints all its buttons, Undo restores. Screenshot baselines added.
close_reason: Speaker Bindings section, missing-speaker warning, replace/undo via speakerReplacements, plugin pushes bindings to PI. Unit-tested; Playwright scenario split to follow-up.

title: Speaker resolver: resolve each button's host by ID, then replacement map, then room name, then saved IP
description: Buttons store uuid/hostAddress/zoneName and use the saved IP directly, so an IP change or speaker replacement breaks every button. Add one resolver used by all action handlers (makeController call sites in sonosActions.js) and by pollingSupervisor (per poll, not first-write-wins in SonosSpeakers.addContext). Order: 1) globalSettings.devices[uuid]; 2) globalSettings.speakerReplacements[uuid] -> devices[newUuid]; 3) same zoneName, prefer non-satellite / group coordinator (careful for EQ action); 4) saved hostAddress. Refresh registry hosts on didReceiveGlobalSettings. On a resolved mismatch, persist the new uuid/hostAddress/title into on-screen buttons via setSettings. Fixes sonos-l07. Real-world case: Office speaker replaced, RINCON_OFFICEOLD01400 (.78) -> RINCON_OFFICENEW01400 (.80).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover all four resolution steps, satellite skipping, and registry host refresh on global settings change; polling and key presses both hit the resolved host.
close_reason: Resolver (device, replacement, room, saved) used by dispatcher and polling; reconciler rewrites on-screen buttons. Verified live: 4 Office buttons on replaced speaker auto-moved to RINCON_OFFICENEW01400 (.80).

title: Quality: test and tooling improvements for future sprints
description: Standing quality track, pulled into sprints as capacity allows. Seeded from the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9) and earlier findings: preview harness fidelity, guidance amendments, layout/feedback consistency checks, screenshot comparison, lint/format scope, dial/rate-limit behaviour bugs, beads commit hook glitch.
acceptance_criteria: Each child closed or explicitly deferred; docs/adding-actions.md reflects the final testing rules.

title: docs/adding-actions.md: amendments from the dial trial + shared next-poll helper
description: Update the guidance with what the trial hit: (a) wrapping (list) dials: burst = net steps modulo list length, net zero sends no call and no alert, 'limits' means wraps at both ends; require a cancel-out test. (b) Rate limiter: >3 failed attempts in 10 s drops input silently, so at most 3 failing gestures per test. (c) How to wait for 'the next poll': ship a helper in tests/playwright/support/ (wait for a Get* issued after the change, then settle, then check last setFeedback) with the debounce spacing constant. (d) Checklist of hand-maintained per-action lists: ACTION_NAMES in actionDispatcher.js, action count in packageIntegrity.test.js, actions array in p4.spec.js, schema/PI gates (or derive them from the manifest). (e) Coverage guard needs willAppear(..., ACTION, ..., 'Encoder') in the test body. (f) Device-only checks list: setFeedback pixmap path + @2x pick, real font width at 16 px, showAlert look on touch strip, debounce feel, TriggerDescription display. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).
acceptance_criteria: All six points are in docs/adding-actions.md; next-poll helper exists in tests/playwright/support/ and is used by at least one spec.

title: Unit test: layouts, setFeedback keys and icon files agree
description: streamdeck validate only checks the layout named in the manifest. Layouts sent at run time via setFeedbackLayout (e.g. encoder-gbar-10-10.json), the keys sent in setFeedback, and icon paths are unchecked, so a typo only shows on the device. Add one generic unit test over all public/layouts/*.json: valid structure, rects in range, every setFeedback key an action emits exists in its layout, every referenced icon file exists. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).
acceptance_criteria: Test covers every layout and encoder action; fails on a renamed layout key or missing icon file (prove once).

title: Preview harness: draw dials from real layout files and full setFeedback
description: harness/preview.js cannot render a new dial faithfully: it keeps a hand-copied LAYOUTS table (duplicated under ./ and / keys) instead of loading public/layouts/*.json, drops setFeedback keys other than title/value/indicator, resolves plugin-relative icon paths under /harness/, ignores showAlert on dial tiles, and wraps text the device would cut. A wrong rect in a real layout never reaches a screenshot. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Preview loads layouts from /layouts/*.json (no hand copy). 2) setFeedback is applied as a partial update including pixmap/icon keys with plugin-relative paths. 3) showAlert renders on dial tiles. 4) Text overflow is clipped like the device. 5) Existing p5/p6 screenshots still render correctly.

title: Test guidance for new actions: agent docs, PR template, CI coverage guard
description: So new dial (and key) functionality always ships with proper tests. Parts: (1) 'Adding or changing a Stream Deck action' section in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, plus fill the Build & Test placeholder; (2) .github/pull_request_template.md with an actions checklist; (3) bd config validation.on-create warn; (4) tests/unit/actionCoverage.test.js: for every manifest action whose Controllers include Encoder, a Playwright spec must drive it via willAppear(..., 'Encoder') and inject every event it registers in actionFunctionMap (dialRotate, dialDown, touchTap). Part 4 depends on sonos-8px.1 (dialDown helper), else it fails on the Audio Equalizer push.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Guidance present in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. 2) PR template shows on new PRs. 3) bd warns on create without acceptance criteria. 4) actionCoverage test passes on the branch and fails if an Encoder action's registered event is not exercised in any Playwright spec (proven once by removing a dialRotate injection). 5) CI green.
notes: Amendments from dial trial: (1) encoder-audio-equalizer registers dialDown with no Playwright test, so the guard needs sonos-8px.1 plus a new EQ push Playwright test (trial used a KNOWN_GAPS entry). (2) The static scan only proves an event is injected somewhere, not asserted; it misses willAppear moved into a helper (false failure) and passes vacuously if registrations are removed. Consider recording (action, event) pairs in the mock host at run time and checking them in Playwright teardown; at minimum document the required willAppear(..., ACTION, ..., 'Encoder') form. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).
close_reason: Docs/PR template/bd validation done earlier; tests/unit/actionCoverage.test.js enforces Playwright coverage of every registered dial event (fails when EQ push test is removed). Full suite: 381 unit, 53 Playwright.

title: Playwright: stateful fake Sonos speaker (bass, treble, mute, play state, play mode)
description: tests/playwright/support/mockSonos.js answers getters from fixed XML fixtures; only volume is stateful (currentVolume). Any dial or key that changes bass, treble, mute, transport or play mode gets the fixture value back on the next poll, so a Playwright test cannot confirm the change stuck (and the poll can visually undo it). Make the mock remember the last Set* value per speaker and report it from the matching Get*: SetVolume/GetVolume, SetBass/GetBass, SetTreble/GetTreble, SetMute/GetMute, Play/Pause/Stop -> GetTransportInfo, SetPlayMode -> GetTransportSettings. Keep fixture values as the initial state and keep existing failure-injection options. Shared by all Playwright specs and by a future interactive dial playground.
acceptance_criteria: 1) For each pair above, a Set* followed by a poll returns the new value from Get*. 2) Initial state still comes from the configured fixtures; existing p1-p7 specs pass unchanged. 3) New Playwright test: turn the Audio Equalizer dial on BASS, then confirm after the next poll the dial still shows the new bass value (not the fixture's -3). 4) Full Playwright suite passes in CI.
notes: Amendments from dial trial: (1) An explicit fixture swap (setActionFixture) must win over the remembered value; otherwise p5-optimistic-rollback breaks (it simulates 'speaker ignored the change' by swapping the GetMute fixture). Trial fix: setActionFixture(action) clears the remembered value. (2) Existing currentVolume is global, not per speaker; make it per speaker. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).
close_reason: mockSonos remembers per host: volume, bass, treble, mute, play mode, Play/Pause/Stop; setActionFixture overrides remembered value (p5-optimistic-rollback passes). p5-eq-dial-push fails with memory disabled.

title: Playwright: dialDown (dial push) helper in mock Stream Deck host
description: The mock Stream Deck host (tests/playwright/support/mockStreamDeckHost.js) can inject dialRotate and touchTap but not dialDown, so pushing a dial is only covered by unit tests (sonosActions.encoder.test.js, lifecycle.test.js). The plugin already handles dialDown (lifecycle.js handlers.dialDown -> callAction). Add the injector to both the in-page window.sd.inject API and createMockHost(), matching Stream Deck's dialDown payload shape (controller Encoder, coordinates, settings). Needed before the two new dials so their push actions can be verified in CI.
acceptance_criteria: 1) mockHost.inject.dialDown(ctx) exists in window.sd.inject and createMockHost. 2) New Playwright test on the existing Audio Equalizer dial: pushing it runs its configured push action (sonos-6sp: mute/unmute, play/pause or next track) against the mock speaker and updates the dial feedback. 3) Test fails if the dialDown handler is removed. 4) Full Playwright suite passes in CI.
close_reason: mockHost.inject.dialDown (dialDown+dialUp); p5-eq-dial-push covers EQ push mute/unmute, one SetMute per push, NONE sends nothing; fails with helper broken.

title: Currently Playing / Play-Pause flash default icon on every track change
description: Fable order review #5. marquee.js:141 passes null while art downloads -> setImage(null) resets to manifest icon until download lands. Fix: ?? undefined like favoriteKeys.js:62; add AbortController timeout to the art fetch (hung fetch leaves default icon forever).
close_reason: New albumArtImage(): undefined while downloading (keep current image), null on no art or recent failure (retry after 60s); art fetch aborts after 10s. Used by marquee render intent and favorite keys.

title: Favorite queue signature read before Sonos finishes filling queue
description: Fable order review #4 (plausible, depends on Sonos async queue fill). sonosActions.js:355-371. getQueueSignature right after Play may differ from the re-poll's signature on large playlists -> key never goes active; immediate re-poll may show previous track. Fix: delay forced re-poll 1-2s; in syncFavoriteKeys accept differing total/updateId when loadedFavorite.uri set and firstTrackUri matches, re-persist.
close_reason: syncFavoriteKeys adopts a newer signature when loadedFavorite's firstTrackUri still matches (queue still filling / edited). The 'stale previous track on re-poll' half was not reproduced: live runs 2026-11-08 showed correct track/art, and sonos-e9y makes the re-poll start only after the action (incl. Play) completed.

title: Volume dial shows empty until the knob is turned
description: Reported 2026-11-08: encoder-audio-equalizer touch strip starts empty after Stream Deck starts; it only shows volume once the knob is adjusted.
close_reason: renderDedupe now sends setFeedbackLayout before setFeedback and re-sends feedback when the layout changes; verified live after restart (dial shows 11 = speaker volume without touching the knob).

title: Play/pause key: TRANSITIONING shown as Paused, toggles wrong way, loses art on state change
description: Root causes (verified live 2026-11-08): (1) Sonos reports CurrentTransportState=TRANSITIONING for >100ms after Play; the post-action immediate re-poll stores it, togglePlayPauseState maps it to 'Paused' until the next poll (~10s). (2) togglePlayPauseKeyDown treats TRANSITIONING as not-playing and sends Play instead of Pause, so pause presses during that window do nothing. (3) renderDedupe sends setImage before setState and dedupes the image; Stream Deck applies setImage to the current state only, so switching Paused->Playing state shows the default play icon instead of album art.
close_reason: Fixed: TRANSITIONING normalized to PLAYING (label + toggle direction), setImage no longer pinned to state 0 (art now shows in Playing state), setState sent before image/title with re-send on state change. Verified live 2026-11-08 with restart->Kendrick->pause->Top Hits->pause->TV sequence.

title: Play-mode icons: shuffle glyphs are not recognisable as shuffle
description: Rendered from assets/icons via bin/render-icons.mjs. repeat_all / repeat_one read fine. shuffle_no_repeat and shuffle_one are chevrons + corner brackets; shuffle_on is chevrons inside a box; none look like the standard crossed-arrows shuffle glyph, and shuffle vs shuffle+repeat vs shuffle+repeat-one are not distinguishable at key size. Redraw: crossed-arrows shuffle base; shuffle_on (SHUFFLE = shuffle + repeat all) adds a small repeat badge; shuffle_one adds a repeat-one badge; shuffle_no_repeat is the plain glyph. Re-render PNG/@2x and update the icon contact-sheet baseline.
close_reason: Shuffle redrawn as the standard crossed-arrows glyph; shuffle+repeat-all and shuffle+repeat-one stack the standard shuffle over repeat / repeat-one; repeat-one digit enlarged. Rendered via npm run icons, deployed.

title: Polling keeps a speaker's old IP after its button is re-saved with a new hostAddress
description: SonosSpeakers.addContext only sets speaker.hostAddress when it is undefined, and lifecycle didReceiveSettings does nothing when the uuid is unchanged. If a speaker's IP changes (e.g. .78 to .80) and the user re-selects the same speaker, key presses use the new IP (from action settings) but the polling supervisor keeps polling the old IP until every context for that UUID disappears or the plugin restarts. Fix: refresh speaker.hostAddress on same-uuid settings changes, or resolve the host from globalSettings.devices[uuid] at poll time (see the connect-for-all design).
close_reason: Fixed: same-uuid host change updates registry host; polling also resolves per poll.

title: Fix sdConnect installStreamDeckBridge guard: Elgato SDK singleton pre-claims connectElgatoStreamDeckSocket global, bridge never installs
description: The browser bundle includes @elgato/streamdeck (imported for EventEmitter per PRD 12.1); its connection singleton assigns window.connectElgatoStreamDeckSocket at module evaluation, BEFORE main.js runs installStreamDeckBridge(). The guard 'if (window.connectElgatoStreamDeckSocket) return' then early-returns, so the real bridge never installs: streamDeckReady never resolves, PluginComponent onMounted suspends forever, no lifecycle wiring, no polling. Masked in p1 because the Elgato shim sends an identical registration frame. Fix: replace the window-global guard with an internal installed flag so our bridge overwrites the SDK global; reset flag in teardownStreamDeckBridge. PRD 12.2 idempotency preserved via the flag.

comments.author: fable-steer

title: Rate-limited speaker ignores key/dial input with no feedback
description: After more than 3 failed attempts in 10 s (MAX_UPDATES / TIME_WINDOW_SECONDS in SonosSpeakers.js), callAction drops input silently: no Sonos call, no alert. The user presses or turns and nothing happens. Show the alert (or another signal) while rate-limited. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).
acceptance_criteria: While rate-limited, a gesture shows an alert on the key/dial; covered by a test.

title: EQ dial sends a redundant SetVolume on a net-zero rotation burst
description: A burst that cancels out (e.g. +1 -1) on the Audio Equalizer dial still sends SetVolume with the unchanged value. Net zero should send nothing. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).

title: Playwright: compare screenshots instead of overwriting them
description: No spec uses toHaveScreenshot; each run overwrites tests/playwright/screenshots/*.png, so visual regressions never fail CI and runs leave render-noise diffs (p4-action-*, p5-nowplaying marquee) that must be restored by hand. Decide: masked toHaveScreenshot comparisons with a tolerance, or keep them as documentation-only images and say so in docs/adding-actions.md. Found in the Play Mode dial trial (worktree branch worktree-agent-ad63c0f66580fc64e, commit f4e51f9, which has a working prototype).

title: PI: Fix button does not reopen Global Settings a second time
description: Found by code reading while writing sonos-fq0 (not reproduced in the app). showSpeakerBindings() in src/components/PiComponent.vue sets forceGlobalsOpen=true and never resets it. If the user clicks Fix, then collapses Global Settings by hand, a second Fix click changes nothing: the accordion's force-expanded prop is already true, so its watcher never calls Collapse.show(), and scrollIntoView targets a hidden section. Fix: reset forceGlobalsOpen when the accordion is hidden, or call show() directly (e.g. toggle false -> nextTick -> true).
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Fix after manually collapsing Global Settings reopens it and scrolls to Speaker Bindings; unit or Playwright test covers it.

title: systemDidWakeUp / titleParametersDidChange / deviceDidConnect don't re-render
description: Fable order review #8 (plausible). lifecycle.js:144. If Stream Deck redraws from manifest on these, plugin images/titles return only when values change. Fix: clearDedupeCache + force render.
close_reason: systemDidWakeUp/deviceDidConnect: clear dedupe, redraw every key from known state, re-poll all speakers. titleParametersDidChange: redraw that key unless the title is an echo of our own setTitle (prevents a marquee loop).

title: PI stale snapshot can undo plugin-side settings writes
description: Fable order review #7 (plausible, narrow). PiComponent.vue saveSettings writes the full object; if reconcileBindings/syncFavoriteKeys wrote first, PI can restore old uuid/favoriteSignature. Fix: PI merge-writes only changed fields.
close_reason: Plugin didReceiveSettings keeps plugin-owned fields: an incoming uuid that resolves (replacement/room) to the current binding is treated as stale; favoriteSignature kept unless the favorite changed (then cleared). Corrections are re-saved.

First verify Stream Deck 7 opens file:// URLs in Explorer rather than failing or opening a browser. Show warning: quit Stream Deck from the tray before editing, it overwrites profiles while running.

close_reason: Replaced non-working openUrl link with copyable path + Copy button; confirmed working on real Stream Deck 7 (Windows)
